description: Full-text search of the PostgreSQL documentation (websearch syntax: "phrase", -term, or), title matches first. Searches the current release unless version (one, e.g. "17") or versions (several) is given; a page matching in several selected versions is one result listing each version and its URL. Returns title, path, url, the versions it matched and a snippet. With define:<term> in query (define:MVCC, define:"write-ahead log", define:T611, define:LATERAL) it also returns definition: the PostgreSQL glossary entry, SQL standard feature or SQL key word for the term, as paragraphs of text segments whose links point at other terms, docs sections and features. Read a page with get_doc_page; cite its postgresql.org/docs url. Search operators apply (intitle:, inurl:, after:/before: pick the versions current then); operators, warnings and skipped report them.

version.description: One documentation version (e.g. "18", "17"; "current" = the current release). Ignored when versions is given.

versions.description: Documentation versions to search, e.g. ["18", "17"] (default: the current release; see list_doc_versions)

name: search_docs
